channel.title: E School News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from E School News (eschoolnews.com)

item.title: From high school to career: 6 CTE trends to track in 2026
item.description: Without a doubt, career and technical education (CTE) is priceless for high school students wanting to get real-world, hands-on job skills before they graduate and turn their interests into career paths.

item.title: The biliteracy advantage: How heritage languages boost English proficiency and workforce readiness
item.description: In just one academic year, Marietta City Schools in Georgia saw the percentage of elementary English learners (ELs) working in or above grade level rocket from 11 percent to 67 percent.

item.title: Too many apps, too many missed messages
item.description: In our district, families were checking multiple apps just to keep up with school communication. One child’s teacher posted in one platform. Another school used something different. District updates lived somewhere else entirely.

item.title: Nearly half of high school students now use AI in college search
item.description: AI is transforming the way students discover, evaluate, and choose colleges, according to a national survey of more than 5,000 high school students conducted by education company EAB.

item.title: In districts, reaching readiness, retention, and success
item.description: It's critical that schools create an environment where students thrive and teachers and staff feel supported and empowered.

item.title: When it comes to student attendance, are districts measuring the wrong thing?
item.description: Across the country, schools are raising alarms about chronic absenteeism. News stories highlight rising numbers of missed days, legislators are demanding answers from districts, and educators are feeling the stress.

item.title: As classrooms go digital, are educators ready?
item.description: Today, about 80 percent of K–12 students use computers or tablets at school--up from about 50 percent before the pandemic. Even as parents worry about too much “screen time,” schools are ramping it up.

item.title: 5 keys to turn escape rooms into classroom inspiration
item.description: Have you ever been to an escape room? For those unfamiliar with the term, an escape room is a structured, problem-solving experience where participants are locked in a room and must use their wits, tenacity, and deductive skills to find a way out.

item.title: Key tips to help district leaders use data to improve attendance
item.description: Chronic absenteeism has become one of the most pressing challenges facing K-12 education today. According to the American Enterprise Institute, chronic absenteeism rates are leveling out at 23.5 percent, still far above pre-pandemic attendance levels.

item.title: The AI-resistant classroom is a myth: Designing assessments that assume AI is present
item.description: Artificial intelligence is no longer approaching the classroom--it is already embedded in it. Students are using generative tools to brainstorm, summarize, translate, draft, and revise.
